Omar El-Sayed: Hi everyone 1 excited to join as an ML infra engineer. Quick wins: my home VPN broke on setup and I can't reach the internal docs. Also didn't get the welcome kit tracking email yet. Who do I ping for that?
Nina Patel: welcome Omar!! :wave: For VPN, follow https://internal.redwood/vpn and drop your OS (mac/linux/win). I can add you to the VPN group now. For the kit, Jill from People Ops usually posts tracking.
People Ops (Jill): hey Omar 1 welcome! Kit shipped yesterday, tracking email was sent to your personal address on file. I'll re-send to your work email. Also submitted badge and building access. Expect the access grant in ~1h.
Omar El-Sayed: thanks Jill. macOS 12.6. VPN client kept failing to authenticate. Do I need extra certs?
Theo Marsh: hey @Omar, sometimes the cert isn't pushed until MDM finishes. Run this and paste output if it errors:
```
scutil --dns
```
If you see no resolver for internal.redwood, MDM hasn't applied yet.
onboarding-bot: Enrollment note: omar.el-sayed device check-in pending; MDM profile applied: false.
DevTools-bot: GitHub invitation sent to omar.el-sayed@redwood.ai (accept within 7 days).
Nina Patel: stickers 1 we usually keep a tub in the kitchen + some at your desk. Want the infrastructure pack (circuit board), or retro logo?
Omar El-Sayed: circuit board sounds awesome. Fun fact: I collect old mechanical keyboards and I brew my own hot sauce. Two truths & a lie: I've built a keyboard with wooden case, I once deploy-rolled-back prod twice in one day, I'm a licensed beekeeper.
Nina Patel: haha welcome hot-sauce keyboard beekeeper 9739ea :joy: We'll grill you at lunch.
People Ops (Jill): added Omar to the "new-hires week 1" calendar and assigned a buddy (Theo). Theo, can you set up a 1:1 for day 1 walkthrough?
Theo Marsh: done 1 scheduled 11:00. I'll cover repo layout, infra runbooks, and where we keep perf dashboards. Omar, ping me if VPN still blocks you and I'll Zoom in.
Omar El-Sayed: great, I'll try the scutil check and report back. Thanks folks 603
